live.canon|luke|8:3: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

live.canon|luke|8:5: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
live.canon|luke|8:6: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
live.canon|luke|8:7: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
live.canon|luke|8:9: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
live.canon|luke|8:10: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of Elohim (God): but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
live.canon|luke|8:11: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of Elohim (God).
live.canon|luke|8:13: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
live.canon|luke|8:14: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
live.canon|luke|8:15: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
live.canon|luke|8:8: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that has ears to hear, let him hear.
live.canon|luke|8:12: Those by the way side are they that hear; then comes the devil, and takes away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

live.canon|luke|8:21: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of Elohim (God), and do it.

live.canon|luke|8:34: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.

live.canon|luke|8:44: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
live.canon|luke|8:47: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

live.canon|luke|8:48: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: your faith has made you whole; go in peace.

live.canon|luke|8:50: But when Yahusha (Jesus) heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.

live.canon|luke|8:55: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
live.canon|luke|8:56: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.

live.canon|luke|24:49: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry you in the city of Jerusalem, until you be endued with power from on high.
live.canon|luke|24:1: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
live.canon|luke|24:2: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
live.canon|luke|24:4: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
live.canon|luke|24:6: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
live.canon|luke|24:7: Saying, The Son of Adam must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
live.canon|luke|24:9: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
live.canon|luke|24:10: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
live.canon|luke|24:11: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
live.canon|luke|24:12: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
live.canon|luke|24:13: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
live.canon|luke|24:17: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that you have one to another, as you walk, and are sad?
live.canon|luke|24:14: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
live.canon|luke|24:15: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Yahusha (Jesus) himself drew near, and went with them.
live.canon|luke|24:16: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
live.canon|luke|24:19: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before Elohim (God) and all the people:
live.canon|luke|24:20: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
live.canon|luke|24:21: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Yashar'el (Israel): and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
live.canon|luke|24:22: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
live.canon|luke|24:23: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
live.canon|luke|24:24: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
live.canon|luke|24:25: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
live.canon|luke|24:26: Ought not Messiah (Christ) to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
live.canon|luke|24:27: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
live.canon|luke|24:28: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
live.canon|luke|24:29: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
live.canon|luke|24:30: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
live.canon|luke|24:31: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
live.canon|luke|24:32: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
live.canon|luke|24:33: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
live.canon|luke|24:35: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
live.canon|luke|24:37: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
live.canon|luke|24:40: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
live.canon|luke|24:42: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
live.canon|luke|24:43: And he took it, and did eat before them.
live.canon|luke|24:44: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
live.canon|luke|24:45: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
live.canon|luke|24:46: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Messiah (Christ) to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
live.canon|luke|24:47: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
live.canon|luke|24:50: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
live.canon|luke|24:51: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
live.canon|luke|24:52: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
live.canon|luke|24:53: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing Elohim (God). Amen.
live.canon|luke|24:34: Saying, the Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon.
live.canon|luke|24:3: And they entered in, and found not the body of Lord Yahusha (Jesus).

live.canon|mark|9:12: And he answered and told them, Elijah verily comes first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of Adam, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.

live.canon|mark|9:19: He answers him, and says, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

live.canon|mark|9:37: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receives me: and whosoever shall receive me, receives not me, but him that sent me.
live.canon|mark|9:38: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in your name, and he follows not us: and we forbad him, because he follows not us.
live.canon|mark|9:41: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because you belong to Messiah (Christ), verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
live.canon|mark|9:43: And if your hand offend you, cut it off: it is better for you to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
live.canon|mark|9:44: Where their worm dies not, and the fire is not quenched.
live.canon|mark|9:45: And if your foot offend you, cut it off: it is better for you to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
live.canon|mark|9:46: Where their worm dies not, and the fire is not quenched.
live.canon|mark|9:47: And if your eye offend you, pluck it out: it is better for you to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God) with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
live.canon|mark|9:48: Where their worm dies not, and the fire is not quenched.

live.canon|mark|9:1: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of Elohim (God) come with power.

live.canon|mark|9:6: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
live.canon|mark|9:7: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
live.canon|mark|9:8: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Yahusha (Jesus) only with themselves.
live.canon|mark|9:9: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of Adam were risen from the dead.
live.canon|mark|9:10: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
live.canon|mark|9:14: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
live.canon|mark|9:15: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
live.canon|mark|9:20: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
live.canon|mark|9:21: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
live.canon|mark|9:26: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
live.canon|mark|9:22: And ofttimes it has cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if you can do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
live.canon|mark|9:23: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, If you can believe, all things are possible to him that believes.
live.canon|mark|9:4: And there appeared unto them Elijah with Moses: and they were talking with Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|mark|9:27: But Yahusha (Jesus) took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
live.canon|mark|9:28: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
live.canon|mark|9:29: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
live.canon|mark|9:30: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
live.canon|mark|9:31: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of Adam is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
live.canon|mark|9:32: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
live.canon|mark|9:34: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
live.canon|mark|9:36: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
live.canon|mark|9:39: But Yahusha (Jesus) said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
live.canon|mark|9:40: For he that is not against us is on our part.
live.canon|mark|9:42: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

live.canon|mark|9:11: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elijah must first come?
live.canon|mark|9:25: When Yahusha (Jesus) saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, You dumb and deaf spirit, I charge you, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
live.canon|mark|9:33: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that you disputed among yourselves by the way?
live.canon|mark|9:24: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help you my unbelief.
live.canon|mark|1:2: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, which shall prepare your way before you.
live.canon|mark|1:3: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare you the way of Yahuah (Lord), make his paths straight.

live.canon|mark|1:11: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
live.canon|mark|1:12: And immediately the Spirit drives him into the wilderness.
live.canon|mark|1:15: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of Elohim (God) is at hand: repent you, and believe the gospel.

live.canon|mark|1:25: And Yahusha (Jesus) rebuked him, saying, Hold your peace, and come out of him.
live.canon|mark|1:27: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commands he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
live.canon|mark|1:37: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for you.
live.canon|mark|1:40: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If you will, you can make me clean.
live.canon|mark|1:41: And Yahusha (Jesus), moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and says unto him, I will; be you clean.
live.canon|mark|1:44: And says unto him, See you say nothing to any man: but go your way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
live.canon|mark|1:1: The beginning of the gospel of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), the Son of Elohim (God);
live.canon|mark|1:4: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
live.canon|mark|1:5: And there went out unto him all the land of Judæa, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
live.canon|mark|1:6: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
live.canon|mark|1:8: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
live.canon|mark|1:9: And it came to pass in those days, that Yahusha (Jesus) came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
live.canon|mark|1:10: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
live.canon|mark|1:13: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
live.canon|mark|1:14: Now after that John was put in prison, Yahusha (Jesus) came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of Elohim (God),
live.canon|mark|1:16: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
live.canon|mark|1:18: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
live.canon|mark|1:19: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
live.canon|mark|1:20: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
live.canon|mark|1:21: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
live.canon|mark|1:22: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
live.canon|mark|1:23: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
live.canon|mark|1:26: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
live.canon|mark|1:28: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
live.canon|mark|1:29: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
live.canon|mark|1:30: But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
live.canon|mark|1:31: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
live.canon|mark|1:32: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
live.canon|mark|1:33: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
live.canon|mark|1:34: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
live.canon|mark|1:35: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
live.canon|mark|1:36: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
live.canon|mark|1:38: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
live.canon|mark|1:39: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.

live.canon|mark|1:43: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;

live.canon|mark|1:17: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Come you after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

live.canon|mark|2:8: And immediately when Yahusha (Jesus) perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason you these things in your hearts?
live.canon|mark|2:9: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Your sins be forgiven you; or to say, Arise, and take up your bed, and walk?
live.canon|mark|2:10: But that you may know that the Son of Adam has power on earth to forgive sins, (he says to the sick of the palsy,)

live.canon|mark|2:17: When Yahusha (Jesus) heard it, he says unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

live.canon|mark|2:21: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up takes away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
live.canon|mark|2:22: And no man puts new wine into old bottles: else the new wine does burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
live.canon|mark|2:25: And he said unto them, Have you never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
live.canon|mark|2:1: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
live.canon|mark|2:2: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
live.canon|mark|2:3: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
live.canon|mark|2:4: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

live.canon|mark|2:12: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified Elohim (God), saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
live.canon|mark|2:13: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
live.canon|mark|2:14: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphæus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
live.canon|mark|2:15: And it came to pass, that, as Yahusha (Jesus) sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Yahusha (Jesus) and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
live.canon|mark|2:19: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
live.canon|mark|2:20: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
live.canon|mark|2:23: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.

live.canon|mark|2:27: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
live.canon|mark|2:28: Therefore the Son of Adam is the Lord also of the sabbath.

live.canon|mark|3:5: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he says unto the man, Stretch forth your hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

live.canon|mark|3:13: And he goes up into a mountain, and calls unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.

live.canon|mark|3:1: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
live.canon|mark|3:2: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
live.canon|mark|3:6: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
live.canon|mark|3:7: But Yahusha (Jesus) withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judæa,

live.canon|mark|3:9: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
live.canon|mark|3:10: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
live.canon|mark|3:12: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
live.canon|mark|3:14: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
live.canon|mark|3:15: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
