live.canon|matthew|23:39: For I say unto you, You shall not see me henceforth, till you shall say, Blessed is he that comes in the name of Yahuah (Lord).
live.canon|matthew|26:2: You know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of Adam is betrayed to be crucified.
live.canon|matthew|26:10: When Yahusha (Jesus) understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble you the woman? for she has wrought a good work upon me.
live.canon|matthew|26:11: For you have the poor always with you; but me you have not always.
live.canon|matthew|26:12: For in that she has poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
live.canon|matthew|26:13: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman has done, be told for a memorial of her.
live.canon|matthew|26:15: And said unto them, What will you give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
live.canon|matthew|26:17: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Yahusha (Jesus), saying unto him, Where will you that we prepare for you to eat the passover?
live.canon|matthew|26:18: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master says, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at your house with my disciples.
live.canon|matthew|26:24: The Son of Adam goes as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of Adam is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
live.canon|matthew|26:25: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, You have said.
live.canon|matthew|26:27: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink you all of it;
live.canon|matthew|26:31: Then says Yahusha (Jesus) unto them, All you shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
live.canon|matthew|26:33: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of you, yet will I never be offended.
live.canon|matthew|26:34: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Verily I say unto you, That this night, before the cock crow, you shall deny me thrice.
live.canon|matthew|26:35: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with you, yet will I not deny you. Likewise also said all the disciples.
live.canon|matthew|26:36: Then comes Yahusha (Jesus) with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and says unto the disciples, Sit you here, while I go and pray yonder.
live.canon|matthew|26:38: Then says he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry you here, and watch with me.
live.canon|matthew|26:39: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as you will.
live.canon|matthew|26:55: In that same hour said Yahusha (Jesus) to the multitudes, Are you come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and you laid no hold on me.
live.canon|matthew|26:62: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest you nothing? what is it which these witness against you?
live.canon|matthew|26:63: But Yahusha (Jesus) held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure you by the living Elohim (God), that you tell us whether you be the Messiah (Christ), the Son of Elohim (God).
live.canon|matthew|26:64: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, You have said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall you see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
live.canon|matthew|26:65: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He has spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.
live.canon|matthew|26:66: What think you? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
live.canon|matthew|26:68: Saying, Prophesy unto us, you Messiah (Christ), Who is he that smote you?
live.canon|matthew|26:69: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, You also were with Yahusha (Jesus) of Galilee.
live.canon|matthew|26:70: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what you say.
live.canon|matthew|26:73: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely you also are one of them; for your speech bewrayeth you.
live.canon|matthew|26:75: And Peter remembered the word of Yahusha (Jesus), which said unto him, Before the cock crow, you shall deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
live.canon|matthew|26:1: And it came to pass, when Yahusha (Jesus) had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
live.canon|matthew|26:3: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
live.canon|matthew|26:4: And consulted that they might take Yahusha (Jesus) by subtilty, and kill him.
live.canon|matthew|26:5: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
live.canon|matthew|26:6: Now when Yahusha (Jesus) was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
live.canon|matthew|26:7: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
live.canon|matthew|26:8: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
live.canon|matthew|26:9: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
live.canon|matthew|26:14: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
live.canon|matthew|26:16: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
live.canon|matthew|26:19: And the disciples did as Yahusha (Jesus) had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
live.canon|matthew|26:20: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
live.canon|matthew|26:21: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
live.canon|matthew|26:23: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
live.canon|matthew|26:26: And as they were eating, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
live.canon|matthew|26:28: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
live.canon|matthew|26:29: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.
live.canon|matthew|26:30: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
live.canon|matthew|26:32: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
live.canon|matthew|26:37: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
live.canon|matthew|26:43: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
live.canon|matthew|26:44: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
live.canon|matthew|26:40: And he comes unto the disciples, and finds them asleep, and says unto Peter, What, could you not watch with me one hour?
live.canon|matthew|26:41: Watch and pray, that you enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
live.canon|matthew|26:42: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, your will be done.
live.canon|matthew|26:45: Then comes he to his disciples, and says unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Adam is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
live.canon|matthew|26:46: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that does betray me.
live.canon|matthew|26:50: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Friend, wherefore are you come? Then came they, and laid hands on Yahusha (Jesus), and took him.
live.canon|matthew|26:47: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
live.canon|matthew|26:48: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
live.canon|matthew|26:49: And forthwith he came to Yahusha (Jesus), and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
live.canon|matthew|26:51: And, behold, one of them which were with Yahusha (Jesus) stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest’s, and smote off his ear.
live.canon|matthew|26:54: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
live.canon|matthew|26:56: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
live.canon|matthew|26:57: And they that had laid hold on Yahusha (Jesus) led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
live.canon|matthew|26:58: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest’s palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
live.canon|matthew|26:59: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Yahusha (Jesus), to put him to death;
live.canon|matthew|26:60: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
live.canon|matthew|26:61: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of Elohim (God), and to build it in three days.
live.canon|matthew|26:67: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
live.canon|matthew|26:71: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth.
live.canon|matthew|26:72: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
live.canon|matthew|26:74: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
live.canon|matthew|26:52: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto him, Put up again your sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
live.canon|matthew|26:53: Thinkest you that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
live.canon|matthew|26:22: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
live.canon|matthew|2:6: And you Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are not the least among the princes of Judah: for out of you shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|matthew|2:8: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when you have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
live.canon|matthew|2:13: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of Yahuah (Lord) appears to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be you there until I bring you word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
live.canon|matthew|2:19: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of Yahuah (Lord) appears in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
live.canon|matthew|2:1: Now when Yahusha (Jesus) was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
live.canon|matthew|2:2: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Yahudim (Jews)? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
live.canon|matthew|2:3: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
live.canon|matthew|2:4: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Messiah (Christ) should be born.
live.canon|matthew|2:5: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
live.canon|matthew|2:7: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
live.canon|matthew|2:9: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
live.canon|matthew|2:10: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
live.canon|matthew|2:11: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
live.canon|matthew|2:12: And being warned of Elohim (God) in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
live.canon|matthew|2:14: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
live.canon|matthew|2:15: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of Yahuah (Lord) by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
live.canon|matthew|2:16: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.
live.canon|matthew|2:20: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Yashar'el (Israel): for they are dead which sought the young child’s life.
live.canon|matthew|2:17: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
live.canon|matthew|2:18: In Ramah was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
live.canon|matthew|2:21: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|matthew|2:22: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of Elohim (God) in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
live.canon|matthew|2:23: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
live.canon|matthew|3:3: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Isaiah, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare you the way of Yahuah (Lord), make his paths straight.
live.canon|matthew|3:2: And saying, Repent you: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
live.canon|matthew|3:7: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
live.canon|matthew|3:10: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which brings not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
live.canon|matthew|3:11: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that comes after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), and with fire:
live.canon|matthew|3:13: Then comes Yahusha (Jesus) from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
live.canon|matthew|3:14: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of you, and come you to me?
live.canon|matthew|3:15: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becomes us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
live.canon|matthew|3:1: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
live.canon|matthew|3:4: And the same John had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
live.canon|matthew|3:5: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
live.canon|matthew|3:6: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
live.canon|matthew|3:8: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
live.canon|matthew|3:9: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that Elohim (God) is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
live.canon|matthew|3:12: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
live.canon|matthew|3:16: And Yahusha (Jesus), when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of Elohim (God) descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
live.canon|matthew|3:17: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
live.canon|matthew|5:13: You are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
live.canon|matthew|5:15: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it gives light unto all that are in the house.
live.canon|matthew|5:20: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, you shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
live.canon|matthew|5:21: You have heard that it was said by them of old time, You shall not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
live.canon|matthew|5:22: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, You fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
live.canon|matthew|5:23: Therefore if you bring your gift to the altar, and there remember that your brother has ought against you;
live.canon|matthew|5:24: Leave there your gift before the altar, and go your way; first be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
live.canon|matthew|5:25: Agree with your adversary quickly, whiles you are in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.
live.canon|matthew|5:26: Verily I say unto you, You shall by no means come out thence, till you have paid the uttermost farthing.
live.canon|matthew|5:27: You have heard that it was said by them of old time, You shall not commit adultery:
live.canon|matthew|5:28: But I say unto you, That whosoever looks on a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
live.canon|matthew|5:29: And if your right eye offend you, pluck it out, and cast it from you: for it is profitable for you that one of your members should perish, and not that your whole body should be cast into hell.
live.canon|matthew|5:30: And if your right hand offend you, cut it off, and cast it from you: for it is profitable for you that one of your members should perish, and not that your whole body should be cast into hell.
live.canon|matthew|5:31: It has been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
live.canon|matthew|5:32: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causes her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced commits adultery.
live.canon|matthew|5:33: Again, you have heard that it has been said by them of old time, You shall not forswear thyself, but shall perform unto Yahuah (Lord) your oaths:
live.canon|matthew|5:40: And if any man will sue you at the law, and take away your coat, let him have your cloke also.
live.canon|matthew|5:42: Give to him that asks you, and from him that would borrow of you turn not you away.
live.canon|matthew|5:43: You have heard that it has been said, You shall love your neighbour, and hate your enemy.
live.canon|matthew|5:45: That you may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he makes his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.
live.canon|matthew|5:46: For if you love them which love you, what reward have you? do not even the publicans the same?
live.canon|matthew|5:47: And if you salute your brethren only, what do you more than others? do not even the publicans so?
live.canon|matthew|5:48: Be you therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
live.canon|matthew|5:1: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
live.canon|matthew|5:2: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
live.canon|matthew|5:3: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
live.canon|matthew|5:4: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
live.canon|matthew|5:5: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
live.canon|matthew|5:6: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
live.canon|matthew|5:7: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
live.canon|matthew|5:8: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see Elohim (God).
live.canon|matthew|5:9: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of Elohim (God).
live.canon|matthew|5:10: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
live.canon|matthew|5:12: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
live.canon|matthew|5:16: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|5:17: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
live.canon|matthew|5:18: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
live.canon|matthew|5:19: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
live.canon|matthew|5:11: Blessed are you, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
live.canon|matthew|5:14: You are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
live.canon|matthew|5:34: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is Elohim's (God’s) throne:
live.canon|matthew|5:35: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
live.canon|matthew|5:44: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
live.canon|matthew|5:36: Neither shall you swear by your head, because you can not make one hair white or black.
live.canon|matthew|5:37: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these comes of evil.
live.canon|matthew|5:38: You have heard that it has been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
live.canon|matthew|5:39: But I say unto you, That you resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
live.canon|matthew|5:41: And whosoever shall compel you to go a mile, go with him twain.
live.canon|matthew|6:1: Take heed that you do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise you have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|6:2: Therefore when you do your alms, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
live.canon|matthew|6:3: But when you do alms, let not your left hand know what your right hand does:
live.canon|matthew|6:4: That your alms may be in secret: and your Father which sees in secret himself shall reward you openly.
live.canon|matthew|6:5: And when you prayest, you shall not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
live.canon|matthew|6:6: But you, when you prayest, enter into your closet, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father which is in secret; and your Father which sees in secret shall reward you openly.
live.canon|matthew|6:7: But when you pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
live.canon|matthew|6:8: Be not you therefore like unto them: for your Father knows what things you have need of, before you ask him.
live.canon|matthew|6:9: After this manner therefore pray you: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be your name.
live.canon|matthew|6:16: Moreover when you fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
live.canon|matthew|6:17: But you, when you fastest, anoint your head, and wash your face;
live.canon|matthew|6:18: That you appear not unto men to fast, but unto your Father which is in secret: and your Father, which sees in secret, shall reward you openly.
live.canon|matthew|6:19: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust does corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
live.canon|matthew|6:20: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust does corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
live.canon|matthew|6:22: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore your eye be single, your whole body shall be full of light.
live.canon|matthew|6:23: But if your eye be evil, your whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you be darkness, how great is that darkness!
live.canon|matthew|6:24: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. You cannot serve Elohim (God) and mammon.
live.canon|matthew|6:25: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what you shall eat, or what you shall drink; nor yet for your body, what you shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
live.canon|matthew|6:26: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are you not much better than they?
live.canon|matthew|6:32: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knows that you have need of all these things.
live.canon|matthew|6:33: But seek you first the kingdom of Elohim (God), and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
live.canon|matthew|6:10: Your kingdom come. Your will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|6:15: But if you forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
live.canon|matthew|6:11: Give us this day our daily bread.
live.canon|matthew|6:12: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
live.canon|matthew|6:21: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
live.canon|matthew|6:27: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
live.canon|matthew|6:13: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For yours is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
live.canon|matthew|6:14: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
live.canon|matthew|6:29: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
live.canon|matthew|6:31: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
live.canon|matthew|6:28: And why take you thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
live.canon|matthew|6:30: Wherefore, if Elohim (God) so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
live.canon|matthew|6:34: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
live.canon|matthew|7:2: For with what judgment you judge, you shall be judged: and with what measure you mete, it shall be measured to you again.
live.canon|matthew|7:3: And why behold you the mote that is in your brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in your own eye?
live.canon|matthew|7:4: Or how will you say to your brother, Let me pull out the mote out of your eye; and, behold, a beam is in your own eye?
live.canon|matthew|7:5: You hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of your own eye; and then shall you see clearly to cast out the mote out of your brother’s eye.
live.canon|matthew|7:6: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast you your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
live.canon|matthew|7:7: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and you shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
live.canon|matthew|7:8: For every one that asks receives; and he that seeks finds; and to him that knocks it shall be opened.
live.canon|matthew|7:11: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
live.canon|matthew|7:12: Therefore all things whatsoever you would that men should do to you, do you even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
live.canon|matthew|7:13: Enter you in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leads to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
live.canon|matthew|7:14: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leads unto life, and few there be that find it.
live.canon|matthew|7:16: You shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
live.canon|matthew|7:17: Even so every good tree brings forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree brings forth evil fruit.
live.canon|matthew|7:19: Every tree that brings not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
live.canon|matthew|7:20: Wherefore by their fruits you shall know them.
live.canon|matthew|7:23: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, you that work iniquity.
live.canon|matthew|7:24: Therefore whosoever hears these sayings of mine, and does them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
live.canon|matthew|7:26: And every one that hears these sayings of mine, and does them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
live.canon|matthew|7:9: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
live.canon|matthew|7:10: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
live.canon|matthew|7:15: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
live.canon|matthew|7:18: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
live.canon|matthew|7:25: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
live.canon|matthew|7:27: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
live.canon|matthew|7:28: And it came to pass, when Yahusha (Jesus) had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
live.canon|matthew|7:29: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
live.canon|matthew|7:1: Judge not, that you be not judged.
live.canon|matthew|7:21: Not every one that says unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that does the will of my Father which is in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|7:22: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in your name? and in your name have cast out devils? and in your name done many wonderful works?
live.canon|matthew|9:2: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Yahusha (Jesus) seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; your sins be forgiven you.
live.canon|matthew|9:4: And Yahusha (Jesus) knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think you evil in your hearts?
live.canon|matthew|9:5: For whether is easier, to say, Your sins be forgiven you; or to say, Arise, and walk?
live.canon|matthew|9:6: But that you may know that the Son of Adam has power on earth to forgive sins, (then says he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up your bed, and go unto your house.
live.canon|matthew|9:9: And as Yahusha (Jesus) passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he says unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
live.canon|matthew|9:11: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eats your Master with publicans and sinners?
live.canon|matthew|9:13: But go you and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
live.canon|matthew|9:14: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but your disciples fast not?
live.canon|matthew|9:16: No man puts a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up takes from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
live.canon|matthew|9:17: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runs out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
live.canon|matthew|9:18: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay your hand upon her, and she shall live.
live.canon|matthew|9:1: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
live.canon|matthew|9:3: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
live.canon|matthew|9:7: And he arose, and departed to his house.
live.canon|matthew|9:8: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified Elohim (God), which had given such power unto men.
live.canon|matthew|9:10: And it came to pass, as Yahusha (Jesus) sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
live.canon|matthew|9:12: But when Yahusha (Jesus) heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
live.canon|matthew|9:15: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
live.canon|matthew|9:19: And Yahusha (Jesus) arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
live.canon|matthew|9:20: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
live.canon|matthew|9:21: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
live.canon|matthew|9:23: And when Yahusha (Jesus) came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
live.canon|matthew|9:22: But Yahusha (Jesus) turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; your faith has made you whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
live.canon|matthew|9:24: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleeps. And they laughed him to scorn.
live.canon|matthew|9:27: And when Yahusha (Jesus) departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, You Son of David, have mercy on us.
live.canon|matthew|9:34: But the Pharisees said, He casts out devils through the prince of the devils.
live.canon|matthew|9:25: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
live.canon|matthew|9:26: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
live.canon|matthew|9:29: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
live.canon|matthew|9:30: And their eyes were opened; and Yahusha (Jesus) straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
live.canon|matthew|9:31: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
live.canon|matthew|9:32: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
live.canon|matthew|9:33: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|matthew|9:35: And Yahusha (Jesus) went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
live.canon|matthew|9:36: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
live.canon|matthew|9:37: Then says he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
live.canon|matthew|9:38: Pray you therefore Yahuah (Lord) of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
live.canon|matthew|9:28: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Believe you that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
live.canon|matthew|10:15: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment, than for that city.
live.canon|matthew|10:8: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely you have received, freely give.
live.canon|matthew|10:11: And into whatsoever city or town you shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till you go thence.
live.canon|matthew|10:14: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when you depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
live.canon|matthew|10:16: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be you therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
live.canon|matthew|10:18: And you shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
live.canon|matthew|10:19: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what you shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what you shall speak.
live.canon|matthew|10:20: For it is not you that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaks in you.
live.canon|matthew|10:22: And you shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endures to the end shall be saved.
live.canon|matthew|10:40: He that receives you receives me, and he that receives me receives him that sent me.
live.canon|matthew|10:41: He that receives a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet’s reward; and he that receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man’s reward.
live.canon|matthew|10:1: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
live.canon|matthew|10:2: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
live.canon|matthew|10:3: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
live.canon|matthew|10:4: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
live.canon|matthew|10:6: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|matthew|10:9: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
live.canon|matthew|10:10: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
live.canon|matthew|10:13: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
live.canon|matthew|10:17: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
live.canon|matthew|10:21: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
live.canon|matthew|10:5: These twelve Yahusha (Jesus) sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter you not:
live.canon|matthew|10:7: And as you go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
live.canon|matthew|10:12: And when you come into an house, salute it.
live.canon|matthew|10:24: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
live.canon|matthew|10:25: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
live.canon|matthew|10:26: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
live.canon|matthew|10:23: But when they persecute you in this city, flee you into another: for verily I say unto you, You shall not have gone over the cities of Yashar'el (Israel), till the Son of Adam be come.
live.canon|matthew|10:28: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
live.canon|matthew|10:29: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
live.canon|matthew|10:30: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
live.canon|matthew|10:32: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|10:33: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|10:34: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
live.canon|matthew|10:35: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
live.canon|matthew|10:36: And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.
live.canon|matthew|10:42: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
live.canon|matthew|10:27: What I tell you in darkness, that speak you in light: and what you hear in the ear, that preach you upon the housetops.
live.canon|matthew|10:31: Fear you not therefore, you are of more value than many sparrows.
live.canon|matthew|10:37: He that loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
live.canon|matthew|10:38: And he that takes not his cross, and follows after me, is not worthy of me.
live.canon|matthew|10:39: He that finds his life shall lose it: and he that loses his life for my sake shall find it.
live.canon|matthew|12:40: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
live.canon|matthew|12:41: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and, behold, a greater than Jonah is here.
live.canon|matthew|12:39: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonah:
live.canon|matthew|12:2: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, your disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
live.canon|matthew|12:3: But he said unto them, Have you not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
live.canon|matthew|12:5: Or have you not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
live.canon|matthew|12:7: But if you had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, you would not have condemned the guiltless.
live.canon|matthew|12:13: Then says he to the man, Stretch forth your hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
live.canon|matthew|12:24: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow does not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
live.canon|matthew|12:30: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathers not with me scatters abroad.
live.canon|matthew|12:32: And whosoever speaks a word against the Son of Adam, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaks against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
live.canon|matthew|12:38: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from you.
live.canon|matthew|12:43: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walks through dry places, seeking rest, and finds none.
live.canon|matthew|12:44: Then he says, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he finds it empty, swept, and garnished.
live.canon|matthew|12:45: Then goes he, and takes with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
live.canon|matthew|12:47: Then one said unto him, Behold, your mother and your brethren stand without, desiring to speak with you.
live.canon|matthew|12:1: At that time Yahusha (Jesus) went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
live.canon|matthew|12:4: How he entered into the house of Elohim (God), and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
live.canon|matthew|12:6: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
live.canon|matthew|12:9: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
live.canon|matthew|12:10: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
live.canon|matthew|12:11: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
live.canon|matthew|12:12: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
live.canon|matthew|12:14: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
live.canon|matthew|12:15: But when Yahusha (Jesus) knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
live.canon|matthew|12:16: And charged them that they should not make him known:
live.canon|matthew|12:18: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
live.canon|matthew|12:19: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
live.canon|matthew|12:20: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
live.canon|matthew|12:21: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
live.canon|matthew|12:22: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
live.canon|matthew|12:23: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
live.canon|matthew|12:25: And Yahusha (Jesus) knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
live.canon|matthew|12:26: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
live.canon|matthew|12:27: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
live.canon|matthew|12:28: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim (God), then the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you.
live.canon|matthew|12:29: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
live.canon|matthew|12:31: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.
live.canon|matthew|12:33: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
live.canon|matthew|12:36: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
live.canon|matthew|12:34: O generation of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
live.canon|matthew|12:42: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
live.canon|matthew|12:17: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying,
live.canon|matthew|12:46: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
live.canon|matthew|12:48: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
live.canon|matthew|12:49: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
live.canon|matthew|12:50: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
live.canon|matthew|12:35: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart brings forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure brings forth evil things.
live.canon|matthew|12:37: For by your words you shall be justified, and by your words you shall be condemned.
live.canon|matthew|12:8: For the Son of Adam is the Lord even of the sabbath day.
live.canon|matthew|13:9: Who has ears to hear, let him hear.
live.canon|matthew|13:10: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speak you unto them in parables?
live.canon|matthew|13:12: For whosoever has, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever has not, from him shall be taken away even that he has.
live.canon|matthew|13:17: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which you see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which you hear, and have not heard them.
live.canon|matthew|13:18: Hear you therefore the parable of the sower.
live.canon|matthew|13:19: When any one hears the word of the kingdom, and understands it not, then comes the wicked one, and catches away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
live.canon|matthew|13:20: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that hears the word, and anon with joy receives it;
live.canon|matthew|13:21: Yet has he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution arises because of the word, by and by he is offended.
live.canon|matthew|13:22: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that hears the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
live.canon|matthew|13:23: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that hears the word, and understands it; which also bears fruit, and brings forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
live.canon|matthew|13:29: But he said, Nay; lest while you gather up the tares, you root up also the wheat with them.
live.canon|matthew|13:30: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather you together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
live.canon|matthew|13:32: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
live.canon|matthew|13:37: He answered and said unto them, He that sows the good seed is the Son of Adam;
live.canon|matthew|13:43: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who has ears to hear, let him hear.
live.canon|matthew|13:44: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man has found, he hides, and for joy thereof goes and selleth all that he has, and buyeth that field.
live.canon|matthew|13:14: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah, which says, By hearing you shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing you shall see, and shall not perceive:
live.canon|matthew|13:52: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which brings forth out of his treasure things new and old.
live.canon|matthew|13:54: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence has this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
live.canon|matthew|13:56: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then has this man all these things?
live.canon|matthew|13:1: The same day went Yahusha (Jesus) out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
live.canon|matthew|13:2: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
live.canon|matthew|13:3: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
live.canon|matthew|13:4: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
live.canon|matthew|13:5: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
live.canon|matthew|13:6: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
live.canon|matthew|13:7: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
live.canon|matthew|13:8: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
live.canon|matthew|13:11: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
live.canon|matthew|13:13: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
live.canon|matthew|13:15: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
live.canon|matthew|13:16: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
live.canon|matthew|13:24: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
live.canon|matthew|13:25: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
live.canon|matthew|13:26: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
live.canon|matthew|13:31: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
live.canon|matthew|13:33: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
live.canon|matthew|13:27: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, did not you sow good seed in your field? from whence then has it tares?
live.canon|matthew|13:34: All these things spake Yahusha (Jesus) unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
live.canon|matthew|13:35: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
live.canon|matthew|13:36: Then Yahusha (Jesus) sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
live.canon|matthew|13:38: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
live.canon|matthew|13:39: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
live.canon|matthew|13:40: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
live.canon|matthew|13:41: The Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
live.canon|matthew|13:42: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
live.canon|matthew|13:45: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
live.canon|matthew|13:46: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
live.canon|matthew|13:47: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
live.canon|matthew|13:48: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
live.canon|matthew|13:49: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
live.canon|matthew|13:50: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
live.canon|matthew|13:53: And it came to pass, that when Yahusha (Jesus) had finished these parables, he departed thence.
live.canon|matthew|13:55: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
live.canon|matthew|13:57: And they were offended in him. But Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
live.canon|matthew|13:58: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
live.canon|matthew|13:28: He said unto them, An enemy has done this. The servants said unto him, Will you then that we go and gather them up?
live.canon|matthew|13:51: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Have you understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
live.canon|matthew|15:5: But you say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever you might be profited by me;
live.canon|matthew|15:6: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have you made the commandment of Elohim (God) of none effect by your tradition.
live.canon|matthew|15:8: This people draws nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
live.canon|matthew|15:11: Not that which goes into the mouth defiles a man; but that which comes out of the mouth, this defiles a man.
live.canon|matthew|15:12: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Know you that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
live.canon|matthew|15:13: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father has not planted, shall be rooted up.
live.canon|matthew|15:16: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Are you also yet without understanding?
live.canon|matthew|15:17: Do not you yet understand, that whatsoever enters in at the mouth goes into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
live.canon|matthew|15:20: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defiles not a man.
live.canon|matthew|15:1: Then came to Yahusha (Jesus) scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
live.canon|matthew|15:9: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
live.canon|matthew|15:10: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
live.canon|matthew|15:14: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
live.canon|matthew|15:15: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
live.canon|matthew|15:18: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
live.canon|matthew|15:19: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
live.canon|matthew|15:21: Then Yahusha (Jesus) went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
live.canon|matthew|15:2: Why do your disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
live.canon|matthew|15:3: But he answered and said unto them, Why do you also transgress the commandment of Elohim (God) by your tradition?
live.canon|matthew|15:4: For Elohim (God) commanded, saying, Honour your father and mother: and, He that curses father or mother, let him die the death.
live.canon|matthew|15:24: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|matthew|15:7: You hypocrites, well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
live.canon|matthew|15:26: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.
live.canon|matthew|15:29: And Yahusha (Jesus) departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
live.canon|matthew|15:23: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she cries after us.
live.canon|matthew|15:28: Then Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto her, O woman, great is your faith: be it unto you even as you will. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
live.canon|matthew|15:34: And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, How many loaves have you? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
live.canon|matthew|15:30: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Yahusha's (Jesus’) feet; and he healed them:
live.canon|matthew|15:31: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|matthew|15:32: Then Yahusha (Jesus) called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
live.canon|matthew|15:33: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
live.canon|matthew|15:35: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
live.canon|matthew|15:36: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
live.canon|matthew|15:37: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
live.canon|matthew|15:38: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
live.canon|matthew|15:39: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
live.canon|matthew|15:25: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
live.canon|matthew|15:22: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, you Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
live.canon|matthew|15:27: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.
live.canon|matthew|16:4: A wicked and adulterous generation seeks after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonah. And he left them, and departed.
live.canon|matthew|16:8: Which when Yahusha (Jesus) perceived, he said unto them, O you of little faith, why reason you among yourselves, because you have brought no bread?
live.canon|matthew|16:10: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
live.canon|matthew|16:11: How is it that you do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that you should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
live.canon|matthew|16:15: He says unto them, But whom say you that I am?
live.canon|matthew|16:16: And Simon Peter answered and said, You are the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God).
live.canon|matthew|16:17: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Blessed are you, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood has not revealed it unto you, but my Father which is in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|16:18: And I say also unto you, That you are Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
live.canon|matthew|16:19: And I will give unto you the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|16:14: And they said, Some say that you are John the Baptist: some, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.
live.canon|matthew|16:1: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
live.canon|matthew|16:5: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
live.canon|matthew|16:6: Then Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
live.canon|matthew|16:7: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
live.canon|matthew|16:12: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
live.canon|matthew|16:13: When Yahusha (Jesus) came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of Adam am?
live.canon|matthew|16:20: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Yahusha (Jesus) the Messiah (Christ).
live.canon|matthew|16:21: From that time forth began Yahusha (Jesus) to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
live.canon|matthew|16:2: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, you say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
live.canon|matthew|16:3: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O you hypocrites, you can discern the face of the sky; but can you not discern the signs of the times?
live.canon|matthew|16:9: Do you not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
live.canon|matthew|16:24: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
live.canon|matthew|16:25: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
live.canon|matthew|16:26: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
live.canon|matthew|16:27: For the Son of Adam shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
live.canon|matthew|16:23: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get you behind me, Satan: you are an offence unto me: for you savourest not the things that be of Elohim (God), but those that be of men.
live.canon|matthew|16:28: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of Adam coming in his kingdom.
live.canon|matthew|16:22: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from you, Lord: this shall not be unto you.
live.canon|matthew|18:3: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except you be converted, and become as little children, you shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
live.canon|matthew|18:5: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receives me.
live.canon|matthew|18:7: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence comes!
live.canon|matthew|18:8: Wherefore if your hand or your foot offend you, cut them off, and cast them from you: it is better for you to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
live.canon|matthew|18:9: And if your eye offend you, pluck it out, and cast it from you: it is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
live.canon|matthew|18:17: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto you as an heathen man and a publican.
live.canon|matthew|18:18: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|18:22: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, I say not unto you, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
live.canon|matthew|18:28: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that you owest.
live.canon|matthew|18:29: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay you all.
live.canon|matthew|18:32: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O you wicked servant, I forgave you all that debt, because you desiredst me:
live.canon|matthew|18:33: Should not you also have had compassion on your fellowservant, even as I had pity on you?
live.canon|matthew|18:35: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if you from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
live.canon|matthew|18:1: At the same time came the disciples unto Yahusha (Jesus), saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
live.canon|matthew|18:2: And Yahusha (Jesus) called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
live.canon|matthew|18:4: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
live.canon|matthew|18:6: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
live.canon|matthew|18:11: For the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost.
live.canon|matthew|18:14: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
live.canon|matthew|18:10: Take heed that you despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|18:12: How think you? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, does he not leave the ninety and nine, and goes into the mountains, and seeks that which is gone astray?
live.canon|matthew|18:19: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|18:20: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
live.canon|matthew|18:23: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
live.canon|matthew|18:24: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
live.canon|matthew|18:25: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
live.canon|matthew|18:27: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
live.canon|matthew|18:30: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
live.canon|matthew|18:31: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
live.canon|matthew|18:34: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
live.canon|matthew|18:13: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoices more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
live.canon|matthew|18:15: Moreover if your brother shall trespass against you, go and tell him his fault between you and him alone: if he shall hear you, you have gained your brother.
live.canon|matthew|18:16: But if he will not hear you, then take with you one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
live.canon|matthew|18:26: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay you all.
live.canon|matthew|18:21: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
live.canon|matthew|19:4: And he answered and said unto them, Have you not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
live.canon|matthew|19:6: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore Elohim (God) has joined together, let not man put asunder.
live.canon|matthew|19:8: He says unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
live.canon|matthew|19:9: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, commits adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away does commit adultery.
live.canon|matthew|19:21: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, If you will be perfect, go and sell that you have, and give to the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
live.canon|matthew|19:27: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed you; what shall we have therefore?
live.canon|matthew|19:28: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That you which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, you also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|matthew|19:29: And every one that has forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
live.canon|matthew|19:1: And it came to pass, that when Yahusha (Jesus) had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
live.canon|matthew|19:2: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
live.canon|matthew|19:3: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
live.canon|matthew|19:5: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
live.canon|matthew|19:7: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
live.canon|matthew|19:10: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
live.canon|matthew|19:11: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
live.canon|matthew|19:12: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
live.canon|matthew|19:13: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
live.canon|matthew|19:14: But Yahusha (Jesus) said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
live.canon|matthew|19:15: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
live.canon|matthew|19:16: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
live.canon|matthew|19:22: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
live.canon|matthew|19:17: And he said unto him, Why callest you me good? there is none good but one, that is, Elohim (God): but if you will enter into life, keep the commandments.
live.canon|matthew|19:18: He says unto him, Which? Yahusha (Jesus) said, You shall do no murder, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not steal, You shall not bear false witness,
live.canon|matthew|19:19: Honour your father and your mother: and, You shall love your neighbour as thyself.
live.canon|matthew|19:20: The young man says unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

live.canon|matthew|22:6: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
